title: Protection Bundle Discount on Comfort Club Dues of a Reinstated Term
content:
Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements dues of a reinstated term carry a bundle discount for members who also hold an active Harbison protection contract. The rule reads how the member's active contract under Harbison Protection Contracts was obtained.

## Protection bundle rule
| Member's active Harbison protection contract | Bundle discount |
|---|---|
| Bought with its installation | 2% (the installation-bundle discount) |
| Obtained any other way | 1% (the other bundle discount) |
| No active protection contract | none |

## Basis questions
**The member bought the contract later, separately from the installation.** 1%.

**The member's contract came with the installation but is no longer active.** No active contract, so no bundle discount.
